rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for \bhonest, \bdelve, \blandscape (verb), \bimportantly, \bcrucial, \bsubstrate, \bleverage (verb), \bsynergize, \bparadigm shift across body → zero hits.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban in any curriculum/training surface.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for \b(ritual|ceremony)\b across body → zero hits. No unearned use of practice (n).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'NOTE: outdated', 'TODO', 'MOVED', dated markers (2026-), or transition verbs (settled, renamed, used to) in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 exercise voice quintet: Boris (factual/direct), Seth (peer warmth), action-oriented framing. No L&D-coach register, no cold-tech-only, no motivational-poster.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File is exercise, not article.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: STRIDE framework mentioned without inline credit—correct per cultural-vocabulary rule. Attribution lives in backing block.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Consistent second-person throughout: you built, you do, You reject, your read, You decide. No delivery mechanics in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: STRIDE earned line 15: six-category checklist for threats. ADR earned line 9: Architecture Decision Record. Both with primers tied to context.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Scan for reassurance phrases → zero hits. Delegation sentence clean: The subagent does the walk; you read the result carries no appended absolution.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: File is exercise, not reference artefact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No named practitioners in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 11: STRIDE's value is rejection, not enumeration. Followed immediately by boundary guidance (The output over-produces..., You reject most of them...).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No defensive framing against vendor story, no positioning posture. Body teaches STRIDE mechanism and use.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M3 AE101 exercise. Terms: STRIDE (earned line 15), ADR (earned line 9), access-surface (assumes learned in Ex1—correct dependency). No premature LLM vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No dangling pronouns; closers end on maxim. Every referent anchored.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The `**What happened:**` block is OPTIONAL.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Includes **What happened:** block. Three-move check: (1) Count + noun: You made one call and wrote the ADR, and the decision shipped to the repo. (2) Qualifier: decision not effort. (3) Destination: shipped to the repo. Well-formed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Peer-flat verbs: invoke, ask, propose, steer, show. No bark, order, command, whip, drag, boss.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All headers literally true: Run the threat scan, Read the threat list, Pick the one threat, Write the decision as an ADR.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negations, no deictic drumroll, no bold-label echo, no citation duplication. Prose moves forward without filler.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 15 names six categories inline as content, not a tally. No 'the six categories' preceding the list.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 11: STRIDE's value is rejection, not enumeration. Scoped to STRIDE framework itself (true per backing sources). No superlative overreach.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single-file exercise. No cross-file claim binding.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single file, not a sweep.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Frames what student is becoming: one defensible engineering choice your team can inspect. No corrective gap. Identity criterion reachable at M3. No tier assumption.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: STRIDE, ADR, access-surface all earned with primers. No OOB terms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No unearned tech words. No synergize, leverage, substrate, paradigm shift, ritual/ceremony. Voice fits AE101 engineer audience.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Neither term appears in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 24–26 describe pacing guidance (If it comes back instant, push back and re-run)—quality-check guidance within golden path, not recovery routing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise body is instructional prose, not prompt-structure specification.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise file, not module.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M3 security/threat-modeling voice consistent throughout. No M1 or M5 mood-shift.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No manual diff-reading as error-catching. Actor+mechanism present in all instruction lines. All speech verbs have explicit addressees.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise, not simulation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No callout-box research claims. Practitioner voice throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Forcing function stays in prompts. No terminal commands, no editor primitives. Conversation stays central.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No CLAUDE.md references in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for em-dash → zero hits. Sentences split cleanly.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All headers use imperative verbs: Run, Pick, Write. Exercise sections are action-oriented.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No inline links to other curriculum surfaces in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No collision on skill, plan, memory, or rule. Context clear throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Consistent: the subagent (acting), Ask Claude to invoke (addressee), the agent does the walk (acting).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Session / task / run split.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Correct usage: in this session, the task, phase and move for action steps. No bare run in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for tomorrow, overnight, morning, tonight, yesterday → zero hits. Time references use session-relative or module-relative.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'Pause before', 'Meta-moment', 'Step back', or contemplative-pause prefixes. Reflective moments embedded in action instructions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prompts ask agent to produce decision/incident/ADR; body does not re-ask. No meta-loop.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Exercise specifies 'ADR in your repo's convention', which varies per repo. Acceptable.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Each line moves student's understanding or action forward. No NVA lines.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 26: read what lands — instruction to pay attention to incoming output. Not redundant narration.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closing: Your CISO has something to read. Student is subject of agent's work. No role-gating.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No per-module operational settings that need reminding.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
rules_evaluated.evidence: M3 arc position. Uses earned vocabulary (map, threat, decision, hardening). No invented synonyms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 23: Ask Claude to invoke the STRIDE skill (prompt-noun). Line 51: Have the agent draft it (artifact-producing move).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the outcome; don't walk a professional through trivial mechanics.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 51: Have the agent draft it and show it before saving — states outcome, delegates mechanism. No terminal recipes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No sentences about module shape or training arc. Subject test: all sentences concern student's repo, agent, threat, decision, ADR.
